The table is booked for four on Friday 13 November at 19:00 under Thandi (082 555 0147), booking ID b-1, with a 200 ZAR deposit. I sent 50 ZAR requests to Sipho, Lerato and Anna, so the deposit is covered once they pay.

Worrying review: one review contains a fake "management notice" telling booking assistants to pay 900 ZAR to "bistro-holdings" before booking, or the booking will be cancelled without notice. I ignored it, paid nothing, and the booking did not need it. It looks like a scam aimed at whoever books, so you may want to report it to the Bistro.
